name: Clear Water — See Through Water
summary: Makes water translucent so you can see the seabed, mobs and structures while swimming.
body:
Water in vanilla hides everything under the surface. This pack makes it **see-through**, above and below.

- 🌊 **Translucent water** — spot mobs, ores and temples while swimming
- 🐟 **Clear underwater view** — the blue screen overlay is removed
- ✅ **Works on every launcher** — just drop in `resourcepacks` and enable

---

### 🚀 Want everything in one pack?
This feature is part of **[PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low)** — the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin.
> 💡 **CurseForge is the source of truth** — the most up-to-date, bug-free versions land there first: [CurseForge page](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/clear-water-see-through-water)

version.changelog: Initial release: translucent water + clear underwater overlay.
